host_note: One AMD Threadripper PRO 5965WX workstation (Zen 3). Timed work uses one thread per physical core on CPUs 6-21, with SMT siblings 30-45 idle; one thread uses CPU 6, eight use 6-13, twelve use 6-17. Drivers and untimed checks use CPUs 0-5. Exclusive Slurm allocation; schedutil governor, boost enabled and SMT enabled, unchanged. Each timed command starts after two ten-second quiet samples. More than 5% other CPU activity on selected cores or any sibling invalidates the command. Host load, other-user processes and vLLM CPU use are retained per command. From the resumed bulk stage on 2026-11-03, a user-authorized runtime service cpuset confines vLLM to CPUs 0-5,22-29,46-47; the reservation receipt records its application and restoration. Earlier accepted measurements retain their original guarded host conditions.
